prompt: We enabled scalar int8 quantization on our collection with 5 million vectors (768 dimensions), but memory usage didn't go down. We set always_ram=true for quantized vectors and on_disk=true for originals. The optimizer shows 'ok' status. What's wrong?

assertions.text: Identifies this as Phase 3C quantization no-op pattern
Explains quantization reduces forced-resident memory, not OS page cache
Recommends checking telemetry for actual data memory vs total (not htop)
Acknowledges the config is actually correct (always_ram=true, on_disk=true) and the 'problem' may just be cache
Mentions full-text indexes as a possible hidden consumer
